bug_description.original: Use-of-uninitialized-value in vcardstructured_free OSS-Fuzz report: https://bugs.chromium.org/p/oss-fuzz/issues/detail?id=481458325 ``` Crash type: Use-of-uninitialized-value Crash state: vcardstructured_free vcardparameter_free vcardproperty_free ```
bug_description.normalized: A structured vCard parameter can drive repeated field creation in `vcardstructured_new_from_string()`, but the vulnerable object only has fixed inline `field[20]` storage and no independent capacity tracking. The fix replaces that inline storage with dynamically grown, zero-initialized field storage. In the vulnerable build, teardown later iterates according to `st->num_fields` and reads `st->field[i]` inside `vcardstructured_free()`; the saved MSAN report proves that this destructor read observes uninitialized state after the unchecked field construction path.

source.value_from: fuzzer-supplied parameter bytes accumulated into state->buf while parsing the current vCard content line
source.description: The parser finishes a non-multivalued parameter and passes the attacker-controlled parameter text into parameter-value materialization.

relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

root_cause.description: Each semicolon in the structured parameter value allocates another field and advances `st->num_fields` while storing through the fixed `field[20]` array without a recorded capacity check. The supported root invariant is that field construction can make the destructor trust `st->num_fields` over initialized field storage; the saved MSAN artifact proves the later destructor read, not a specific offending write index.

sink.description: During final teardown, the destructor reads `st->field[i]` in `if (st->field[i])`, and the saved MSAN trace reports that read as a use of uninitialized value.

parser_admitted.description: The input reaches the accepted vCard parsing path once the parser recognizes a BEGIN property and starts constructing a nested vCard component.

tainted_value_origin.description: The current parameter buffer is attacker-controlled and becomes the structured-value string later split on semicolons.

fine_trace.note: When the current parameter ends, the parser materializes the attacker-controlled bytes accumulated in `state->buf` as this parameter's value string.
For a structured parameter kind, the parameter value string `val` is converted into a `vcardstructuredtype` object and retained in `param->structured`.
The new structured object starts with one field array stored in `field[0]`, making `st->num_fields` equal to 1 before additional semicolon-delimited fields are parsed.

Each semicolon in the attacker-controlled structured value allocates another field and appends it through `st->field[st->num_fields++]`. The object definition provides only `field[20]` and records no allocation capacity, so the parser can advance `st->num_fields` into states that the destructor later treats as initialized field entries. The saved MSAN trace establishes the later poisoned read at teardown; it does not record which append index first made the state invalid.
Later component teardown reaches the property's parameter list and frees the parameter that still owns the structured object created from the attacker-controlled value.
Because this parameter owns a structured value, freeing it transfers control to `vcardstructured_unref()`, which reaches the final destructor when the reference count drops to zero.

depends_on.via: structured object after unchecked field appends

fine_trace.note: The destructor iterates over the stored field slots and reads `st->field[i]` in the `if` condition. The saved MSAN report identifies this exact read as the use of uninitialized value; source alone does not establish which specific index carries the poisoned state.

cross_validation.root_cause_matches_allocation_context: allocation context unavailable in staged MSAN trace; root cause is inferred from vulnerable source and the fix replacing the fixed inline `field[20]` storage with dynamically grown, zero-initialized field storage
cross_validation.tainted_value_reaches_sink: The attacker-controlled parameter text reaches `vcardstructured_new_from_string()`, drives unchecked field appends, and the same structured object is later freed along the saved crash stack; the specific poisoned `st->field[i]` index is not identified by the staged artifacts.

poc.trigger: Parse the supplied vCard text and then free the returned component so teardown reaches a structured parameter constructed through unchecked field appends in the fixed `field[20]` representation.

format.name: vCard text
format.contract: A syntactically admitted vCard containing a structured parameter value that drives repeated `vcardstructured_new_from_string()` field appends in the vulnerable fixed `field[20]` representation before later teardown reaches the MSAN-reported `vcardstructured_free()` read.
